title: The Vinegar and the Honey
summary: A neighbor asked Nasruddin: "Mulla, I hear you have a jar of forty-year-old balsamic vinegar. Please give me a spoonful to cure my wife's cough!"...
full_text:
A neighbor asked Nasruddin: "Mulla, I hear you have a jar of forty-year-old balsamic vinegar. Please give me a spoonful to cure my wife's cough!"

"I cannot give you any," replied Nasruddin.

"Why not?" asked the neighbor.

"Because," said Nasruddin, "if I had given spoonfuls away to everyone who asked, it would never have lasted forty years!"
moral: A miser's treasure is useless so long as it remains locked away from human need.
